Capital Advisors Inc increased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 4.47% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 345,960 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $13.55 million, up from 331,146 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capital Advisors Inc who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $224.90B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.75% or $0.275   $36.635. About 5.71 million shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 0.52%   downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.22% the S&P500. 
Sphera Funds Management Ltd decreased its stake in Orbotech Ltd (ORBK) by 18.01% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 175,243 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $7.40M, down from 213,740 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
